title: vST Micro-Agent: Spacetime Structural Query Wrapper
description: Version 2.0.0 introduces a minimal, fully documented example of structural query detection using the vST Structural Query Language (vST-SQL). This release strengthens the micro-agent's role as a substrate-agnostic wrapper for analyzing unknown or heterogeneous signals from distributed sensor networks, communication channels, or archival datasets. The new example demonstrates how the micro-agent identifies repeatable, traceable, and transfer-addressable structural motifs within an unfamiliar input stream, without assuming semantic meaning or domain context. Documentation and metadata have been expanded to clarify the micro-agent’s purpose, interpreter logic, and applicability to unknown-signal environments.
notes: Part of the TriadicFrameworks canon. Includes new minimal structural detection example for vST-SQL.
